statements.statement: Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered for the patient
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope (R55)
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The monitoring is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
